setup: Kneel on an exercise mat with your knees set wider than hip-width apart and your big toes touching.
Sit back so your glutes rest on or near your heels.
steps: Hinge at the hips and walk your hands straight out in front of you along the floor.
Lower your torso between your thighs until your forehead rests comfortably on the mat or a block.
Extend your arms fully, pressing your palms into the floor while simultaneously sinking your hips back toward your heels.
Hold the position for the prescribed duration while maintaining slow, relaxed breathing.
To exit, slowly walk your hands back toward your knees and sit upright.
instructions.breathing: Breathe deeply and smoothly into the back and sides of your ribcage, using each exhale to sink deeper into the hips and shoulders.
cues: Let the chest melt to the floor

common_faults.fault: Excessively lifting the hips off the heels to reach farther forward.
common_faults.correction: Prioritize anchoring your hips down toward your heels rather than overreaching with your hands.

common_faults.fault: Shrugging the shoulders up into the ears with excessive muscular tension.
common_faults.correction: Keep space between your shoulders and ears while allowing the upper back and lats to passively lengthen.

precautions: If you experience knee or ankle pain from deep flexion, place a rolled towel behind the knees or under the tops of the feet for support.

name: Extended Child's Pose
summary: A resting yoga stretch performed from kneeling with the hips back toward the heels and arms reaching forward to decompress the spine, shoulders, and hips.
